content: In the develop workflow implementer prompt (step 4), when a seed adds or edits tests in a crate, the pre-gate check is cargo nextest run -p <touched-crate> (full crate suite) instead of ONE focused test; when tests are untouched, compile check or ONE focused test still applies. Workspace-wide suite always forbidden. Evidence: run 01M20T9S8JRXETASN64768TRRP — targeted-only tests missed two pre-existing fabro-server Docker-socket failures, gate-red bounce cost ~22 min (~40% of the run).
